input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable. The termination of selected Service Option Attachments will not affect Customer's obligation to pay charges under other Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: This is a hosting/services agreement, but § 3.5 Effect of Termination addresses only Customer's accrued payment obligations. Searches across the document for transition, migration, export, retrieval, return and deletion language returned nothing relevant: § 11.6 makes Customer solely responsible for Content but gives no exit rights, § 14.18 Data Protection covers only contact information and processing instructions, and § 14.2 Survival simply preserves § 3.5. With no data return right at all, the agreement sits in walk-away territory under this rule, so we insert the preferred exit clause (six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Content in machine-readable format within 30 days, certified deletion thereafter) into § 3.5, noting 90 days of assistance as an available fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, Content return and certified deletion obligations into § 3.5 Effect of Termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only accrued payment obligations, so we have added an exit clause giving us up to six months of transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of our Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Content in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all Content from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
